Policy 13/XI/9204641/0 · valid to 16 Aug 2027

NICU: from the 250k limit with pre-approval — not from the 10,000

Newborn on mother's card for 30 days — add the baby to GIG before day 30

Congenital conditions not covered for the baby — get every answer in writing
